verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a Mercury feature for scheduling recurring jobs, workflows, payments or transfers. 'Automatic invoices' and a community mention of 'auto-funding rules' are adjacent automations with no stated schedule or recurrence. Running Mercury operations from a script or CI pipeline would rely on an external scheduler, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
